'''Drefin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Serving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]], Drefin was one of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Dracen]]'s chief advisers.<ref name="Toxic Clash" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Drefin appears on Quesh in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Toxic Clash" />
